mode: non-isolated -- run against the project's real, current dev DB (backend/app.db), populated by Prompts 2-5, no new ingestion, no reset. Real Gemini API calls (GEMINI_API_KEY configured), bounded to 3 accounts x 2 endpoints (6 calls) plus one additional safe in-memory zero-transaction call pair, to keep external API exposure minimal.
endpoint_discovery_note: Confirmed via whole-codebase grep of every @router.get/post across app/routes/*.py that these are the only 2 Bank-prefixed AI endpoints; Ecommerce and Sales have their own separate /ai/playbook endpoints, out of scope for this prompt.

schema_validation.recommendations_source: 18 from 3 real accounts' financial-health-playbook (5 primary + 5 savings + 8 wallet) + 2 from the safe in-memory zero-transaction sparse test; lender-brief's own recommendations never generated in any tested case (see B6-1)
schema_validation.notes: entity_type always the valid literal 'account'; urgency always one of the 3 valid literals; confidence_score always within [0.0, 1.0]; all string fields non-empty; created_at always a syntactically valid ISO 8601 timestamp (though not grounded to real time -- see B6-3). No recommendation would be dropped by parse_recommendations().

grounding_validation.objective: Cross-check every AI-generated factual claim against real, independently-verified Prompt 3/4/5 numbers.
grounding_validation.non_ai_generated_sections_grounding: sections.business_overview / income_stability / cash_flow_analysis / loan_readiness_assessment / risk_flags in the lender-brief, and the data fed into financial-health-playbook's recommendations, are computed directly by the same compute_* functions already verified in Prompts 3-5, not by the LLM. Every numeric value checked (income_stability score/cv_pct/label, abm_3m/6m/12m/trend, cash_buffer_months, expense_concentration_ratio_pct, loan_readiness_score/tier/score_breakdown, fraud_risk_score/risk_level, estimated_debt_coverage figures) for all 3 accounts matched the corresponding Prompt 3/4/5 reference values exactly, including the pre-existing B4-1 wrong 'improving' label for the primary account.

ai_generated_narrative_grounding.hallucinations_of_fact: None found in narrative/reasoning text; the revenue_at_stake field itself is the only fabricated element.
None -- revenue_at_stake values here (6 of 8) are exact matches to real context figures, the best-grounded of the 3 accounts tested.

Correctly and independently identifies that loan_readiness_score=100/Tier A is misleading because only fraud_risk_inverted contributed -- this matches the real B5-2 defect exactly, self-identified by the model from context alone

grounding_validation.lender_recommendation_grounding: Not applicable in any tested case -- Gemini call failed for the lender-brief endpoint in all 4 attempts (3 real accounts + 1 sparse test), so sections.lender_recommendation was always [] with no content to ground. See B6-1.

hallucinations_found: No hallucinations of financial fact (invented account events, invented transactions, invented metric values) were found in any AI-generated reasoning/recommended_action/trigger_condition text across all 20 recommendations read.

The only confirmed fabrications are in 2 required-but-unconstrained AIRecommendation fields: revenue_at_stake (fabricated with no traceable basis when context offers no natural anchor -- B6-2) and created_at (never grounded to real generation time -- B6-3).

previous_issue_impact.detail: Wrong 'improving' abm_trend label and its inflated 25.0/25.0 loan-readiness contribution appear verbatim in the primary account's lender-brief, with no caveat; also suppresses an abm_trend improvement_recommendation entry.

Savings account's cash_buffer_months=null / disabled_components include cash_buffer in the lender-brief, consistent with the known transfer-flag contamination; the AI's own recommendation attributes this to generic data-completeness, not the true root cause (not visible in its context).

risk_flags.statement_integrity.sequential_ordering='failed' for the primary account in the lender-brief, consistent with prior findings.
Confirmed does NOT propagate -- neither AI endpoint calls compute_cashflow_forecast or references cash-runway/forecast concepts anywhere in context or output.

issues_found.summary: lender_recommendation is always empty (4/4 real Gemini calls failed) due to an 8-second timeout applied per-attempt inside a 3-retry loop, when the real Gemini response for this prompt consistently takes longer than 8s but succeeds within the sibling endpoint's default 30s timeout.

revenue_at_stake is fabricated with no traceable basis whenever the account's real data offers no natural anchor value (savings account 5/5, sparse test 2/2); well-grounded only when a real anchor value exists (wallet, some of primary).
created_at is never grounded to real generation time across all tested recommendations -- schema-valid but semantically fabricated.
Lender-brief endpoint has no disabled_features signaling at any level, compounding B5-2's inflated zero-transaction score with the least guardrail messaging of any Bank endpoint tested.

summary: Both Bank AI endpoints exist, are reachable, return the correct response envelope, and produce schema-valid AIRecommendation objects. All non-AI-generated numeric content in both endpoints is grounded exactly to real, independently-verified Prompt 3/4/5 data, including faithful (if undesirable) propagation of pre-existing issues B4-1/B5-2/B5-3/B3-1/B2-3/B5-4. No hallucinations of financial fact were found in any AI-generated narrative text; the model's qualitative reasoning was consistently accurate and in one case self-diagnosed a known defect (B5-2) unprompted. However, a new critical defect (B6-1) means the lender-brief's own AI recommendation section has never once succeeded in this environment, and two schema fields (revenue_at_stake, created_at) are unreliable placeholders whenever the model lacks a real anchor value. None of these issues are data-corruption or crash risks; all degrade silently and safely.
